stories.title: Concerns over security costs for Christmas markets
stories.summary: Organisers say police advice to buy expensive equipment has seen some festive events cancelled.

stories.title: Sessions aim to 'show what real men are like'
stories.summary: A scheme to tackle violence against women and girls "empowers" men to challenge bad behaviour.

stories.title: Rail commuters face tough winter, MPs warn
stories.summary: A reduced service, a vulnerable coastal line and poor wi-fi are among the issues passengers face.

stories.title: Department store opening bucks high street decline
stories.summary: Austins, which began trading in Newton Abbot in 1924, opens a new menswear shop.

stories.title: GWR workers vote in favour of strike action
stories.summary: Staff vote to take industrial action in a dispute with the rail operator over pay and conditions.

stories.title: Hundreds of trees being planted in public spaces
stories.summary: Torridge District Council plans to plant trees and hedgerow 14 public spaces.

stories.title: University students 'brave the shave' to raise £1m
stories.summary: Students at the University of Exeter have their heads shaved in support of Movember.

stories.title: Fishermen call for level playing field with Europe
stories.summary: Fishermen say they are at a competitive disadvantage as EU boats receive subsidies for fuel.

stories.title: Debate paused on MP's bill for second-home controls
stories.summary: MP Andrew George wants second-home owners in seaside and rural communities to apply for planning permission.

stories.title: Port marks 300 years of clay trade
stories.summary: The Port of Teignmouth in Devon handles more than 160,000 tonnes of clay each year.

stories.title: Riding instructor returns to work after paralysis
stories.summary: Sandra Jones is back coaching and judging dressage after breaking her neck, back and spinal cord.

stories.title: Community projects recognised with King's Awards
stories.summary: Litter-pickers, regatta organisers and a women's mental health charity are among the winners.
